rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, grounding it in eBay/Winter and reading §10(j)'s "just and proper" as incorporating the traditional four-factor test while noting labor-specific harms can satisfy irreparable harm and public interest. Separate writings are most likely from Sotomayor (purposive defense of the reasonable-cause framework) and from Gorsuch/Thomas/Alito (Article III and anti-deference emphases), with Jackson or Barrett possibly writing to stress practical application of Winter in labor disputes.
